ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 5, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 3:00 PM

Vivian Shimoyama, Chair  Nima Novin, Commissioner
John Thomas, Vice Chair  Jayro Sandoval, Commissioner
Milton Duena, Commissioner  Robert Smith, Commissioner
Erica Jacquez, Commissioner  Brenda Wunsch, Commissioner
Austin Metoyer, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO ECONDEVCOMMISSION@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-56004 Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Economic Development
  Commission meeting of Wednesday, November 6, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-56005 Recommendation to receive and file Executive Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-56006 Recommendation to receive and file an update on Economic Development
  Department 2024 highlights and upcoming 2025 activities.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-56008 Recommendation to receive and file follow up responses provided by Technology
  and Innovation staff that relates to their October 2, 2024, Digital and Economic
  Inclusion presentation update.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-54262 Recommendation to appoint Commissioner Sandoval and Commissioner Wunsch to
  the Economic Development Revolving Loan Subcommittee.

  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 3:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Economic Development Commission on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact (562) 570-5503
